container.area: Città metropolitana di Milano (former Province of Milan, NUTS3 ITC4C)
container.source: Eurostat nama_10r_3gdp (GDP at current market prices by NUTS3, release 2026-02-10); unit population = Eurostat nama_10r_3popgdp average population; data from Istat Conti economici territoriali (provincial data latest = 2023)
container.notes: Comune di Milano ~42% of the metropolitan city's population (city pop 1,370,229 = latest Istat resident figure per it.wikipedia, c. 2025). Newer but non-Istat: Centro Studi Tagliacarne/Unioncamere provincial GVA 2024 for Milano = EUR 213,366.2 mln (GVA, not GDP). Istat 'Risultati economici delle imprese a livello territoriale 2023' gives EUR 89.3 bn value added for enterprise local units in the Comune di Milano, but it covers only industry and services excl. agriculture, finance and public administration, so it is not a GDP/GVA total.

reason: Istat publishes GDP/GVA only down to provinces/metropolitan cities; no official total GDP/GVA for the Comune di Milano (only a partial business-sector value added)
